answer: Sybils must fund every clone, and the cost compounds faster than rewards, much as a river erodes many channels into one bed. Each agent must lock a stake that decays along a downward spiral if peers flag it as duplicate; fresh identities then face a rising entry cost, like a nebula condensing from diffuse gas into a single dense core. Honest agents stake once and recover it, so forgery stays economically irrational. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
